games.player_slots_a: Player count depends on your plan. While you can change the limit to anything supported by the game, our base plans support fewer players while premium plans can handle more players.
games.uptime_a: Yes, all servers run in reliable datacenters with our uptime guarantee, regardless of your plan.
games.custom_start_q: Can I use my own start file?
games.custom_start_a: Yes, you can upload and run custom executables via our control panel for full server customization.
games.backups_a: Yes, servers include multiple backup slots and configure backup scheduling in the panel to save a copy of your server daily.
games.hardware_a: Modern build configurations with NVMe storage, DDR5 memory and at minimum 10Gbps fiber connectivity. While we primarily use Ryzen 9 9950X3D processors and all systems meet our rigorous performance standards, specifications vary slightly across our fleet. For specific hardware details of the server you will be provisioned on, please contact our sales team.
games.plan_change_q: Can I change my plan later?
games.plan_change_a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your server plan anytime from the billing panel with just a couple clicks.
games.unmetered_q: How are unmetered or unspecified resources handled?
games.unmetered_a: Unmetered RAM plans automatically scale to 100MB above current usage, up to the limits of the system which are generally 256GB DDR5. Some software like forge require a hard limit so your server starts as 32GB and you contact support for a manual increase. For unspecified resources like bandwidth, we generally allow unlimited usage.
games.support_a: We help with billing, software crashes, and outages. While we don't configure mods or plugins, we have detailed documentation and can generally can steer you in the right direction.

websites.login_q: How do I log in to the panel?
websites.login_a: You can log in to your website control panel through the client area. For CMS-specific logins (like WordPress), add /wp-admin to your domain.
websites.plugins_a: Yes, all our website hosting plans support plugin installation for compatible content management systems.
websites.storage_q: How much storage do I get
websites.storage_a: Storage space varies by plan. Basic plans start at 5GB, while premium plans offer significantly more or unlimited storage.

databases.upgrade_q: Can I upgrade at any time?
databases.upgrade_a: Yes, you can seamlessly upgrade your database plan at any time. The changes will be applied with minimal to no downtime.
databases.storage_q: How much storage do I get?
databases.storage_a: Storage allocation depends on your chosen plan. Our starter plans begin at 2GB and scale up to 50GB or more with premium plans.
databases.support_a: Yes, we provide technical support for all database services. Premium plans include priority 24/7 support from our database experts.
databases.backups_a: Yes, all database plans include automated backups. All plans include the ability to schedule daily backups.

developers.upgrade_q: Can I upgrade at any time?
developers.upgrade_a: Yes, you can upgrade your bot hosting plan at any time as your requirements grow.
developers.login_q: How do I log in to the panel?
developers.login_a: You can access your bot control panel through our client area with the credentials provided in your welcome email.
developers.support_a: Yes, we offer technical support for bot deployment and hosting issues. Community support is also available for code-specific issues in our Discord.
developers.languages_a: We support bots built in Python, JavaScript (Node.js), Golang, Java, PHP, and other popular programming languages.
